title_zh: 长城:山脊上的徒步路线
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (10/20): Hiking the Great Wall's Ridgelines
note_en: The pattern 既…也… links two things that are equally true of the same subject: 爬长城既是锻炼身体，也是一种精神上的体验 "climbing the wall is both physical exercise and a kind of spiritual experience." It works like English "both... and...," but the verb is repeated in each half (既是…也是…); the text closes with the same pattern: 既是对身体的考验，也是对心灵的礼物. Compare 不仅…更… in 长城不仅是军事历史的见证，更是…象征, which ranks the second item as more important, like "not only... but above all."
